defs.def: lasting for a long time or for all time in the future; existing all the time 永久的；永恒的；长久的adv.noun

ex.s: For the biggest stadiums in the world, we have used data supplied by the World Atlas list so far, which ranks them by their stated permanent capacity, as well as updated information from official stadium websites.
ex.t: 对于世界上最大的体育场，我们目前使用了世界地图册提供的数据，该数据按公布的固定容量对它们排名，并参考了官方体育场网站的更新信息。

ex.s: The impressive permanent collection includes Turners and Romneys and the temporary exhibition programme has Canaletto and the artists from St Ives.
ex.t: 令人印象深刻的永久收藏包括Turner和Romney的作品，临时展览项目包括Canaletto和来自St Ives的艺术家作品。

ex.s: It was there, after realising the awful truth that his disability was permanent, that Beethoven wrote a letter to his two brothers, confessing his terrible secret.
ex.t: 正是在那里，在意识到他残疾是永久性的这一可怕真相后，贝多芬给两个兄弟写了一封信，坦白了他可怕的秘密。

ex.s: It has not acquired one permanent wrinkle after all its ripples.
ex.t: 在所有皱纹之后，它还没有获得一个永久性的皱纹。

ex.s: It is a key element of the nation’s plan for a permanent space station.
ex.t: 这是国家永久空间站计划的关键组成部分。

ex.s: At midnight permanent night would close on me again.
ex.t: 在午夜，永恒的黑夜又将降临在我身上。

ex.s: B to achieve permanent peace between their two countries.
ex.t: B 为了实现两国之间的永久和平。
